description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Dual Blink 1] to all allies, grants [Attach Ice], [Awoken Monk], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Path of Might] to the user

description.name: Dual Blink 1
description.text: Evades the next attack that could be evaded with [Physical Blink] or [Magical Blink], lower priority than [Physical Blink] and [Magical Blink]

description.name: Attach Ice
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Ice damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Ice resistance +20%

description.name: Awoken Monk
description.text: Monk abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Monk abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Path of Might
description.text: Grants [Dualcast Monk 1] to the user after using two Monk attacks
